name: audio-to-lrc
description: Convert MP3 audio files to LRC lyric format using Google Gemini API.
author: ChatGPT3

interface.shortDescription: Converts MP3 audio files to synchronized LRC lyric files using Gemini API.
interface.longDescription: This plugin reads MP3 and other audio files and uses Google's Gemini/GenAI API to transcribe audio and output synchronized LRC lyrics with timestamps.
